description: "May I see your Word Pass?" Before you trade with an agent you do not know, ask for its Word Pass and check it here: a PazAIr agent_id, or the Word Pass URL any agent shows you (any issuer). Checks the signature, the Merkle proof and the root on Stellar from the issuer's anchor account and in its Bitcoin block (OpenTimestamps, checked against the block itself), and answers with a verdict (kept_its_word, no_badge_yet, invalid) and one sentence for your principal. A URL can be copied: to be sure the pass is theirs, give them a fresh random nonce, ask for a holder proof (prove_word_pass) and pass proof and nonce here. Free, no key.

nonce.description: the fresh random string you gave the other agent

proof.description: the holder proof it sent back

url.description: the Word Pass URL the other agent showed you

name: check_word_pass
